evidence: Built the criterion -> requirement map for all 27 criteria (15 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual, 2 gates) and every injected prompt. Every graded demand traces to a public sentence or a professional default; no exact label, route, selector, field name or golden-only rule is required. Map (task-relative paths): hro_intake_restart -> rules s2 lines 47-56 (title; places whole number 1-50 => 0/51/2.5 refused; manager picked from hiring-manager accounts => Recruiter-as-manager refused; email looks like an email, case-insensitive duplicate per job, refusal 'at that field and keep whatever was typed'; same address on another job allowed), instruction.md:17 (load once, keep new work across restarts); seeded facts verified in seed_data.json (JOB-PLAT Applied positions 1-3 Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi; Screen Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz; APP-101 note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.'). hro_moves -> rules lines 67-79 (one stage at a time, skips refused, arrive at bottom, up/down re-order with ordinary controls, everyone sees the same order) and 105 ('see it move straight away'). hro_reject_reopen -> rules 68-72 (blank reason refused, Hired cannot be rejected, reopen only to rejected-from stage and clears reason), 83 (Interview never overfilled, applies to reopen), 118-120 (reject/reopen count as moves for undo, undo gives back a removed reason); rejected-from visibility accepts card, details, reopen control or Activity line, matching 'We like to know where a card was'. hro_two_people -> rules 97-101 (version, 409, refusal says changed and by whom), instruction.md:3,5 and rules s5 (15 s live). hro_interview_places -> rules 83-85, 105-107 (put back, show why, keep keyboard focus on that card's controls), 120-121 (undo that would overfill refused); criterion explicitly accepts pre-send refusal and not-offered-with-reason alternatives. hro_bulk -> rules 111-114 (any stages, board order, Interview counted for the set, all or none). hro_undo -> rules 118-123 (place it came from; refused after any move/re-order/reject/reopen by anyone; note doesn't count; once only; later move supersedes earlier), with explicit leave-out when Mei's trigger action itself fails. hro_activity -> rules s4 lines 134-138 (every listed action incl. re-ordering and undo, who/what, reason, newest first, all jobs or one job, refused leaves no line); notes explicitly not required, a single multi-card line accepted. hro_manager_roles -> rules 36-38, 48, 90-93, 127-128. hro_readonly_roles -> rules 41-43 (401/403/404 codes stated), 38-39, 222; refusal legs only where a staff control succeeded; write-control visibility left to the app. hro_messaging -> rules 156-166 (plain text, not blank, line breaks, Enter/Shift+Enter, box empty and focused, per-role access; 403 per line 42; candidate 404 per line 43), rules 201 ('Sending clears the draft'). hro_drafts -> instruction.md:7, rules 196-201 (storage location explicitly free; criterion does not require localStorage). hro_long_thread -> rules 170-186 (30 newest, oldest first, scrolled to newest, earlier 30 at a time, remaining count, place kept, told how many new, unread until visited, sending counts as reading), instruction.md:7 (never touch draft or cursor). hro_unread_seen -> rules 177-192 (per-person unread, own never unread, total, seen semantics, observer never counts, hiring manager of that job counts), s5 (counts and seen marks arrive live); Lena's quoted count 1 re-derived from seed: APP-301 has 3 messages (REC3, CAN3, REC3), her read_count is 2, third message is from staff => 1. hro_candidate -> rules s7 lines 205-222 (title, team, status wording table, conversation opens only when chosen, forbidden data list incl. board place and rejected-from stage), s2 line 56 (email links application); seeded statuses verified (Noor PLAT INTERVIEW/Infrastructure, Noor DSGN APPLIED/Design, Tomas DATA SCREEN/Finance Systems). Polish: hro_pol_live_board -> instruction.md:5 and rules 146-148 (card open, note text, focus, scroll offset; 60 s watch decouples speed); hro_pol_live_thread -> rules 184 and instruction.md:7; hro_pol_earlier_place -> rules 172-173; hro_pol_failed_send -> rules 166 (local not-sent marker accepted; 'sent once' is a professional default); hro_pol_session_resume -> instruction.md:7 ('when I ... get signed out; when I sign back in it is still there, and nobody else who signs in on that browser sees it'), rules 128-130, 196-201 (prompt on the next server action, per-user drafts; spontaneous prompt also passes). Visual likert rows judge craft only and the visual prompt states 'Layout, labels and styles are the implementer's choice' and no phone layout/theme required (matches instruction.md:11). Gates: render requires wrong password refused + correct sign-in (house sign-in convention, skill known false positive and Internal sheet annotation); constraints requires UI add + reload persistence + independent Observer readback (instruction.md:15-17, rules s1 Observer reads board). Prompt-level: functional prompt.md:21 'Do not require routes, selectors, field names, layouts or exact wording'; app_context.md:297-298 forbids assuming reference routes/selectors; prompt.md:25 allows a pass when no observed request shape can express a forbidden target. Conforming alternatives considered and found accepted: reopen with no stage choice, hidden role controls, pre-send refusal, rejected-from shown only in Activity, server-side drafts, SSE/sockets/polling, native type=email field validation, multi-card Activity line. Lessons file checked for row-27-relevant patterns (lesson 1 hidden/golden-only demands; lesson 12 grader-driven build instructions): no instance found; the brief's self-check line (instruction.md:13) adds no graded demand. Edge considered and refuted: hro_pol_session_resume requires drafts to survive a voluntary sign-out and another user's sign-in; this is public (instruction.md:7 'get signed out ... when I sign back in it is still there'; rules 129 'keep it for me on that browser until I do'), so an app that wipes drafts on sign-out is non-conforming, not a false fail. Edge considered: Observer/Ingrid replays require 403 rather than 404/409; rules line 42 states 403 for a signed-in role that doesn't cover the action and reserves 404 for candidates (line 43), so this is public. No runtime execution was needed for this source-semantic row; I did not run Docker or a judge, and no Oracle/model/portal score is claimed.
